item.title: Ask HN: Developer looking for freelance or contract work(400 USD/week)
item.summary: I'm a developer with 4+ years of experience building production web applications for startups and clients. My primary stack is React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. I've also worked with React Native, Three.js, and GSAP, building everything from SaaS dashboards to interactive websites. I'm looking for freelance or contract opportunities (short or long term). Dm me on discord(kiyo151) if you are interested. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49268702 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
